WITH categoria_reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.product_category_name_english, r.review_score
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
),
promedio_reviews AS (
  SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM categoria_reviews
),
categoria_mala_calif AS (
  SELECT product_category_name_english
  FROM categoria_reviews
  GROUP BY product_category_name_english
  HAVING AVG(review_score) < (SELECT avg_review_score FROM promedio_reviews)
),
categoria_retrasos AS (
  SELECT product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retrasos
  FROM vw_entregas_retrasos v
  JOIN categoria_reviews cr ON cr.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_category_name_english
),
promedio_retrasos AS (
  SELECT AVG(retrasos) AS avg_retrasos
  FROM categoria_retrasos
),
categoria_buen_retraso AS (
  SELECT product_category_name_english
  FROM categoria_retrasos
  WHERE retrasos < (SELECT avg_retrasos FROM promedio_retrasos)
)
SELECT cm.product_category_name_english
FROM categoria_mala_calif cm
JOIN categoria_buen_retraso cb ON cb.product_category
